name: ai-coding-protocols
description: Manifest of agent skills: own skills (in skills/) plus third-party dependencies installed via the skills CLI (npx skills add). Third-party skills are declared, never committed.

own.note: Auto-discovered from skills/ — each directory with a SKILL.md. Install with: npx skills add didacrios/ai-coding-protocols

dependencies.note: MIT. Canonical origin of the engineering skills previously vendored via skillquarium (unlicensed mirror) and adapted by the opencode harness. Pinned to a tag for reproducibility; the skills CLI lockfile pins the resolved commit. Add more from the 25-skill catalog as needed: browser-testing-with-devtools (needs Chrome DevTools MCP), frontend-ui-engineering, git-workflow-and-versioning, observability-and-instrumentation, etc. Twelve of these are also shipped (adapted) by the OAK kit as its own skills; scripts/install-skills.mjs skips those when the kit is present so opencode never sees two skills with one name. Declared anyway: a harness without the kit needs them.
code-review exists in both repos; only one is installed (own emoji-driven variant lives in skills/code-review)
